units: <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:10">Meg. IV, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Megillah 25a:16">25ᵃ</cite>) <he>מעשה ת׳ נקרא ומיתרגם</he> the story of Tamar (<cite ref="Genesis 38:24">Gen. XXXVIII</cite>) is read (in the synagogue) and translated.

Gen. R. s. 92 (ref. to Gen. XLIV, 16) מה נאמר לאדני במעשה ת׳ וכ׳ what have we to say to my lord (for our justification) about the story of Tamar, what to speak about the story of Bilhah (Gen. XXXV, 22) ? Gen. R. s. 85; a. fr.—2) Absalom’s sister.
<cite ref="Megillah 25b:3">Meg. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>מעשה אמנון ות׳ וכ׳</he> the story of Amnon and Tamar (<cite ref="II Samuel 13:32">II Sam. XIII</cite>) may be read and translated.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:16">Ab. V, 16</cite> <he>אהבת אמנון ות׳</he> Amnon’s love of T.

senses.gloss: a woman that informed against the Rabbis before Roman authorities.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:2:6">Y. Meg. III, 74ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="V00710"><he>תַּמְרוּרִים</he></cite>
